arc.grandline.storm_throne.why: Ten thousand metres up, the Sky People have lived for six years under 'God' Cirrus Tenjōin, who calls every thunderclap a divine judgment. He has sealed the ruins of Shandora on Upper Yard and set four priests on its trails, each holding a trial.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.amarante: Amarante Kumoi, gatekeeper of Heaven's Gate. Entry is one billion extol; nobody has ever paid it.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.ferris: Ferris Kaigara, dial-smith of Angel Island. Her Tone Dial caught the god plotting, not praying.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.lumi: Lumi Hanegumo, waver courier. Runs on wind from a dial and on gossip.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.wakiza: Chief Wakiza Ōtori of the Shandian guardians, whose forest was once a city with a bell the whole sea could hear.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.ayasha: Ayasha Ōtori, the Bell-Ringer, who has polished Shandora's golden bell every morning for sixty years without being allowed to ring it.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.isidore: Professor Isidore Kumoyomi of Weatheria, who can prove every 'judgment' arrived on a storm's timetable.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.pinwheel: Penelope 'Pinwheel' Kazaguruma, the Professor's young weathercaster. Makes rainclouds indoors.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.ilse: Ilse Wanazawa, Priestess of Snares (the Trap-Trap Fruit). Every root a snare.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.garamond: Garamond Kusabi, Priest of Links (the Chain-Chain Fruit). Paid by the link.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.lulla: Lulla Yumeshiro, Priestess of Slumber (the Sleep-Sleep Fruit). Pilgrims who sleep in her trial never wake.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.oswin: Oswin Fūkyō, Priest of Gales: no fruit, an Impact Dial, a Breath Dial and forty years of practice.
arc.grandline.storm_throne.cast.cirrus: 'God' Cirrus Tenjōin, the Storm Throne, with the Weather-Weather Fruit.
recap.grandline.sky_1: Rode the Knock Up Stream into the White Sea, passed Heaven's Gate and reached Angel Island.
recap.grandline.sky_2: Heard the Tone Dial's secret and the town's rumours, and reached the forbidden Upper Yard.
recap.grandline.sky_3: Passed the Trials of Snares and Links.
recap.grandline.sky_4: Passed the Trials of Slumber and Gales.
recap.grandline.sky_5: On Weatheria, proved the god's judgments are only weather, and had a gold-wire conductor made from Shandora's gold.
recap.grandline.sky_7: The golden bell of Shandora rang at last, and the poneglyph of Shandora was read again.
recap.grandline.sky_8: Carried a message from the Cloud End to Aria, the Sky People girl who fell to the Blue Sea.
scene.grandline.sky_1.start.1: amarante|Welcome to Heaven's Gate, ten thousand metres up. Entry is one billion extol per person. ...You don't have a billion extol. Nobody ever has. Go on through.
scene.grandline.sky_1.start.2: amarante|Angel Island is past the cloud bank. Mind the god. He hears everything up here, they say. I wouldn't know. I just work the gate.
scene.grandline.sky_1.end.1: narrator|Angel Island: white houses on a sea of cloud, wavers skimming between them, and a chapel bell-tower with a fresh lightning scorch down one side.
scene.grandline.sky_1.end.2: lumi|Blue-Dweller! Down from — no, UP from the Knock Up Stream? Hold on to something. Did you hear? The god struck the chapel again. From a clear sky. Ferris the dial-smith says it wasn't a judgment. Ferris says a lot of things.
scene.grandline.sky_2.start.1: ferris|Shells remember, you know. Wind, light, sound. This Tone Dial was on the chapel roof the night of the last 'judgment'. Listen.
scene.grandline.sky_2.start.2: narrator|The shell crackles. A voice, bored and close: '...the chapel next, I think. They've been praying too little. And have the priests clear the Shandians off Upper Yard by the new moon.'
scene.grandline.sky_2.start.3: ferris|That's not a prayer. That's a plan. Talk to Lumi — she knows every rumour — and to the chapel priest. Then go and see what's on Upper Yard.
scene.grandline.sky_2.end.1: narrator|The chapel priest won't meet your eyes. 'We pray to the god because the god listens,' he says, very quietly. 'That is the trouble.'
scene.grandline.sky_2.end.2: lumi|Upper Yard's forbidden. Which means it's exactly where everyone wants to go. Hold tight — the waver's faster than the gossip.
scene.grandline.sky_3.start.1: wakiza|This forest was a city once: Shandora. A bell rang here that the whole sea could hear. The man who calls himself god sealed our ruins and set four priests on our trails.
scene.grandline.sky_3.start.2: wakiza|Four trials: Snares, Links, Slumber, Gales. Pilgrims who fail them are never seen again. My people can't pass them. Perhaps a Blue-Dweller can.
scene.grandline.sky_3.end.1: ilse|Every root here was a snare, and every snare was mine... how did you step round them ALL?
scene.grandline.sky_3.end.2: garamond|Paid by the link. Never short of work. ...Until today, it seems.
scene.grandline.sky_3.end.3: wakiza|Two trials broken. Two remain, deeper in: the Dream-Priestess, and the old man with the dials.
scene.grandline.sky_4.end.1: lulla|Hush... you were supposed to sleep... nobody ever... wakes...
scene.grandline.sky_4.end.2: oswin|Forty years, and nobody stood up after the first blow. You stood up after the fourth. Go on, then. He's waiting, and he isn't as patient as I am.
scene.grandline.sky_4.end.3: wakiza|The trails are open. My people walk their own forest tonight for the first time in six years. But the god still holds the sky. Find out how to fight the weather.
scene.grandline.sky_5.start.1: isidore|Every 'divine judgment' in the White Sea for six years arrived exactly when our forecasts said a storm would. Lightning, young sailor, is not a god. It is a timetable.
scene.grandline.sky_5.start.2: pinwheel|And lightning goes where it's easiest! Hold a gold wire to the ground and it goes into the ground instead of you. Probably! Shandora's gold is the best there is. Bring me some?
scene.grandline.sky_5.end.1: pinwheel|Gold wire, wound and grounded, and a weather staff to aim it. Don't touch the tip. The Professor touched the tip.
scene.grandline.sky_5.end.2: isidore|And here is tomorrow's forecast: a storm at noon over Upper Yard, the biggest of the year. He'll call it his greatest judgment. Be there.
scene.grandline.sky_6.start.1: cirrus|Kneel. The sky has judged you, and the sky is mine. Every thunderclap in the White Sea is my voice — and I have so much left to say.
scene.grandline.sky_6.end.1: narrator|The lightning comes down on schedule — into Pinwheel's gold wire, into the ground, and not into you. Cirrus Tenjōin goes down under a sky that was only ever weather.
scene.grandline.sky_6.end.2: wakiza|Six years. Six years, and he was a man with a forecast. ...Climb Giant Jack. My mother has something she has been waiting to do.
scene.grandline.sky_7.start.1: ayasha|I climbed Giant Jack every morning for sixty years to polish a bell I was not allowed to ring. My knees remember every step. Help an old woman with the rope.
scene.grandline.sky_7.end.1: narrator|The golden bell of Shandora rings out over Upper Yard, over the White Sea, and down through the clouds to the Blue Sea below, where — people will say later — sailors on Jaya looked up.
scene.grandline.sky_7.end.2: ayasha|There. Now read the stone, Blue-Dweller. It has waited longer than I have.
scene.grandline.sky_8.start.1: canal_guide|You're the one from the Blue Sea? There's a message here from Angel Island for a girl who fell off the edge years ago. Aria Fuusen. You know her?
scene.grandline.sky_8.end.1: aria|A message? For me? From up HERE? ...It's from my mother. She still sets a place at the table. Every night. For nine years.
scene.grandline.sky_8.end.2: aria|I'm not going home yet. But I'm going to write back. Will you carry it? You're the only post that goes up the Knock Up Stream.
arc.grandline.lantern_abyss.why: Ten thousand metres down, Ryugu Kingdom's queen was shot ten years ago for a petition to bring the island into the sun, and the island blamed a human. Now half the palace guard has been bought with drugged pearls, and nobody can tell which half.
arc.grandline.lantern_abyss.cast.perla: Madame Perla Sango of Mermaid Cove, who lets humans in on Ume's word.
arc.grandline.lantern_abyss.cast.marisol: Princess Marisol Umisachi, the Pearl of Ryugu, who carries her mother's pen and petition.
arc.grandline.lantern_abyss.cast.sawara: General Tetsuo 'Ironfin' Sawara of the Coral Guard, who cannot tell which half of his guard is loyal.
arc.grandline.lantern_abyss.cast.nereo: King Nereo Umisachi, the Tidecrown: huge, gentle, and grieving.
arc.grandline.lantern_abyss.cast.tidwell: Tidwell Kaisō, keeper of the Sea Forest, the queen's grave and the stone she died defending.
arc.grandline.lantern_abyss.cast.okoze: Doctor Sculpin Okoze, druggist of the Abyssal Tide, brewer of the Abyss Pearls.
arc.grandline.lantern_abyss.cast.lorcan: Captain Lorcan Ankō, 'the Lantern of the Abyss', of the Fish-Man supremacist crew the Abyssal Tide.
recap.grandline.fmi_1: Dove from Sabaody in Ume's bubble and reached Fish-Man Island.
recap.grandline.fmi_2: Met Princess Marisol and General Sawara: the island is uneasy, and the guard is divided.
recap.grandline.fmi_3: Broke the turncoats in the Coral Guard and their druggist, Doctor Okoze.
recap.grandline.fmi_4: Gathered names for the Sunlit Petition and took it to King Nereo.
recap.grandline.fmi_5: Lit the queen's grave in the Sea Forest and read the stone she died defending.
recap.grandline.fmi_6: Broke the Abyssal Tide, who shot the queen.
recap.grandline.fmi_7: Read the stone of the Sunken Ruins for the king, as a friend of the deep.
recap.grandline.fmi_8: Rose to the New World Gate as Fish-Man Island's ally.
scene.grandline.fmi_1.start.1: ume|Ten thousand metres down, love, with nothing but my bubble between you and the whole sea. Don't poke it. Don't let anyone else poke it. Fish-Man Island is at the bottom.
scene.grandline.fmi_1.end.1: narrator|At the bottom of the world, in the dark, a light: a bubble the size of a mountain, and inside it coral towers, a palace, and sunlight carried down through the roots of a great tree.
scene.grandline.fmi_2.start.1: perla|Humans aren't usually allowed in the Cove, darling — but Ume vouched for you, and Ume has never vouched for a bore. Sit. Tea, kelp-cake or gossip?
scene.grandline.fmi_2.start.2: perla|Gossip it is. The island's uneasy: the guards attack visitors, the king never leaves the palace, and the princess is carrying her mother's petition around again. Go and meet them.
scene.grandline.fmi_2.end.1: marisol|My mother gathered a hundred thousand names on a petition to bring our island into the sun. Someone shot her for it in the plaza. They say it was a human. I have her pen, and a hundred thousand names to go.
scene.grandline.fmi_2.end.2: sawara|Half my guard wears the Abyssal Tide's pearl under their armour, and I can't tell which half. Until I can, every guard in this palace is your enemy as well as mine.
scene.grandline.fmi_3.end.1: okoze|One pearl and a guard fights like ten... two and he forgets his king... you... weren't supposed... to need three...
scene.grandline.fmi_3.end.2: sawara|Okoze's pearls. Now I can tell which half. Thank you, surface-dweller. That's a debt.
scene.grandline.fmi_4.end.1: nereo|My wife believed in the sun. I stopped believing the day they shot her. ...But you carried her petition up my stairs, little surface friend, with three more names on it.
scene.grandline.fmi_4.end.2: nereo|I will sign it. And I will finish what she started.
scene.grandline.fmi_5.start.1: tidwell|Mind the graves, mind the wrecks, and mind the stone most of all. Our queen died in the plaza, but she lived here, reading that stone over and over. It is a promise someone carved and could not keep.
scene.grandline.fmi_5.end.1: narrator|The sea pickles glow along the rows of graves. At the end lies the queen's, and beside it a poneglyph, chipped where a bullet struck it ten years ago.
scene.grandline.fmi_5.end.2: tidwell|She stood in front of it. The bullet that killed her was meant for the stone — a Fish-Man bullet, from a Fish-Man gun. Not a human's. She knew. That's why they killed her.
scene.grandline.fmi_6.start.1: lorcan|The surface took our sunlight, our children and our queen's patience. My lantern shines down here, human. Follow it, and you'll learn what the deep does with the light.
scene.grandline.fmi_6.end.1: narrator|Captain Lorcan Ankō goes down in Gyoncorde Plaza, where the queen fell. His lantern rolls across the stones and goes out.
scene.grandline.fmi_6.end.2: marisol|It was them. All along. Not a human. ...My mother's murderer is lying in front of me, and all I want to do is read the petition out loud. So I will.
scene.grandline.fmi_7.end.1: nereo|The Sunken Ruins remember what the surface forgot. Thank you for reading them as a friend.
scene.grandline.fmi_8.end.1: agathe|Welcome to the New World, rookie. Your Log Pose is about to grow three needles and have a nervous breakdown. And — a letter of passage from King Nereo? Well. Nobody touches your ship in my harbour.
arc.grandline.jade_camellia.why: The Government has summoned every Warlord to the war at Marineford, and the Kuja empress refuses to go. She might change her mind — for someone who impresses her.
arc.grandline.jade_camellia.cast.hisui: Hisui Benitsubaki, empress of the Kuja and a Warlord of the Sea (the Mythical Zoan Yamata-no-Orochi). Bows to nobody.
recap.grandline.lily_1: Reached Amazon Lily and earned the empress's respect in a duel.
arc.grandline.hermits_silence.why: Before the war there is one thing worth learning: how to listen. The hermit who taught two Emperors lives alone on Rusukaina.
arc.grandline.hermits_silence.cast.tsuku: Tsukumo Okina, the hermit of Rusukaina, who taught Haki to two Emperors.
recap.grandline.rusukaina_1: Found the hermit Tsukumo on Rusukaina, and learned to listen.
arc.grandline.descent.why: The Lamplighter is held six levels down in Impel Down, the prison nobody leaves, until she is moved to Marineford to die.
arc.grandline.descent.cast.grimsby: Chief Warden Grimsby Rōgoku of Impel Down. Nobody has left his prison except as paperwork.
recap.grandline.impel_1: Went down into Impel Down after the Lamplighter, and the breakout led straight to the war.
arc.grandline.lamplighter_execution.why: The Government will burn Haruka 'the Lamplighter' Lanthorn — the last person alive who has seen the final island — in public at Marineford, to end the Saltfire Age.
arc.grandline.lamplighter_execution.cast: Haruka 'the Lamplighter' Lanthorn, the Saltfire King's navigator. Old Wick's sister.
Vice Admiral Osric 'Old Anchor' Funayama, who trains the recruits.
Fleet Admiral Constance Ironwake, who has never bent.
The Emperor Hrolf Kumobashi, the Saltfire King's old rival and friend, who sails into the bay to take Haruka back.
recap.grandline.war_1: Sailed into the crescent bay of Marineford as the war began.
recap.grandline.war_2: Reached the Lamplighter on the execution platform.
recap.grandline.war_3: The war is over and the Warlord charter has burned. Haruka left you one last sentence, and a pose for the New World.
arc.grandline.last_blade.why: The world's strongest swordsman lives alone on Kuraigana Island and trains anyone who can survive a blade like his.
arc.grandline.last_blade.cast.jinpachi: Jinpachi Grimaldi, ex-Warlord, the world's strongest blade.
recap.grandline.kuraigana_1: Crossed swords with Jinpachi Grimaldi on Kuraigana Island.
arc.grandline.counterfeit_flame.why: At the gate of the New World the pirates wait for rookies — and on Punk Hazard a Government lab is forging an artificial Saltfire, a flame that burns on salt water.
arc.grandline.counterfeit_flame.cast.ser: Vice Admiral Seraphine Glasswater of G-5, the Marine base everyone pretends doesn't exist.
arc.grandline.counterfeit_flame.cast.aga: Harbourmaster Agathe Minatoya of the New World Gate.
arc.grandline.counterfeit_flame.cast.hes: Dr. Hesper Galvani, who has nearly made the Throne its flame.
recap.grandline.nw_gate_1: Survived the New World's welcome at the gate.
recap.grandline.punk_1: Stopped Dr. Galvani's counterfeit Saltfire on Punk Hazard.
arc.grandline.marionette.why: Dressrosa's Colosseum offers a Road Poneglyph rubbing as its grand prize — and its beloved king is a puppet whose strings run to the Fence.
arc.grandline.marionette.cast.florian: King Florian Castañuela, very beloved, because he pays everyone to say so.
recap.grandline.dress_1: Fought through the bouts of the Marionette Colosseum.
recap.grandline.dress_2: Cut King Florian's strings and claimed the first rubbing.
arc.grandline.tiny_tyrant.why: On Green Bit the smallest Warlord in history is terrorising the Tontatta — and their best inventor won't build his cannons.
arc.grandline.tiny_tyrant.cast.bolt: Bolt Nejimaki, a Tontatta inventor building a cannon that fires smaller cannons.
arc.grandline.tiny_tyrant.cast.pipistrel: Pipistrello 'the Drill Lord' Minimaro, ex-Warlord. Small. Magnificent. Shouts.
recap.grandline.greenbit_1: Beat the Drill Lord on Green Bit (looking down the whole time).
recap.grandline.recruit_bolt: Field-tested Bolt's inventions; he'll join you if you ask.
arc.grandline.thunder_mane.why: Zou walks the sea on a giant's back, and its guardian signed the Government's charter so no fleet would ever come for it. The second rubbing is his to give — after an honour duel.
arc.grandline.thunder_mane.cast.leonhart: Leonhart Raijū, the Thunder-Mane, ex-Warlord and guardian of Zou. Smells lies.
arc.grandline.thunder_mane.cast.pashmina: Pashmina Torafu, a Mink guard too restless for guarding.
recap.grandline.zou_1: Won the honour duel with the Thunder-Mane and the second rubbing.
recap.grandline.recruit_pashmina: Won the Thunder-Mane's leave for Pashmina; she'll join you if you ask.
arc.grandline.midnight_carnival.why: Whole Cake Island is a fair that never ends, and its visitors never leave. The third rubbing belongs to the Emperor who runs it.
arc.grandline.midnight_carnival.cast.mar: Marzipan 'Sugarplum' Candlewick, who keeps the books on every soul that wanders in.
arc.grandline.midnight_carnival.cast.bar: The Emperor Barnum 'Waxwork' Candlewick, ringmaster of the Midnight Carnival.
recap.grandline.cake_1: Broke into the Midnight Carnival past its acrobat.
recap.grandline.cake_2: Beat Sugarplum and the Emperor Waxwork, and took the third rubbing.
arc.grandline.flower_capital.why: Wano lives under the Kraken's protectorate and a puppet shogun, and a ronin with a debt is looking for someone to stand with.
arc.grandline.flower_capital.cast.rin: Rin Tsukishiro, the moonlit ronin, whose master did not bow.
arc.grandline.flower_capital.cast.hagane: Shogun Hagane Oboro, who calls the Kraken's protection peace.
recap.grandline.wano_1: Broke the shogun's enforcers and the shogun himself.
recap.grandline.recruit_rin: Rin has seen Onigashima with her own eyes; she'll join you if you ask.
arc.grandline.krakens_wager.why: The Emperor of Onigashima never refuses a bet and never forgives a cheat. The fourth rubbing is on his table.
arc.grandline.krakens_wager.cast.rin: Rin Tsukishiro, with a sword and a debt.
arc.grandline.krakens_wager.cast.gorou: Gorou 'Riptide' Kanemitsu, the Kraken's enforcer. Takes tribute.
arc.grandline.krakens_wager.cast.tsubaki: Tsubaki 'Backwash' Shiranami, the Kraken's two-bladed enforcer.
arc.grandline.krakens_wager.cast.kurogan: The Emperor Kurogane 'the Kraken' Shiomaru, who wagers everything.
recap.grandline.oni_1: Beat the Kraken's enforcers on Onigashima.
recap.grandline.oni_2: Won the Kraken's wager, and the fourth rubbing.
arc.grandline.genius_and_shadow.why: The Government's greatest scientist wants to defect from Egghead, and CP0 has come to make sure she doesn't.
arc.grandline.genius_and_shadow.cast.min: Professor Minerva Tensai, alone for six years with forty-nine robot assistants.
arc.grandline.genius_and_shadow.cast.elo: Elowen Hoshizora, the Professor's assistant, here for the telescope and a star that never moves.
arc.grandline.genius_and_shadow.cast.ves: Vespera Kagenui of CP0, who collects shadows.
recap.grandline.egghead_1: Stood with Professor Minerva against CP0's Vespera on Egghead.
recap.grandline.recruit_elowen: Saw Minerva safe; Elowen will join you if you ask.
arc.grandline.green_dawn.why: The Revolutionary Army is almost ready, and its plan needs everyone who still believes every night ends.
arc.grandline.green_dawn.cast.sigrun: Sigrun 'the Dawnbringer' Yoake, Supreme Commander of the Revolutionary Army.
arc.grandline.green_dawn.cast.lysander: Lysander 'Firefly' Hotaru, her chief of staff, who counts the fireflies.
arc.grandline.green_dawn.cast.prudence: Vice Admiral Prudence 'Steel Sermon' Hagane of New Marineford, who draws only for something worth protecting.
recap.grandline.baltigo_1: Heard the plan for the green dawn on Baltigo.
arc.grandline.fifth_emperor.why: Sterling 'the Fence' Okanemochi — the man behind the Sabaody auction and Dressrosa's strings — stole the holder list at Marineford and bought himself an Emperor's seat.
arc.grandline.fifth_emperor.cast.sterlin: Sterling 'the Fence' Okanemochi, who weighs everything: a crown, a secret, a friend.
recap.grandline.hachinosu_1: Brought down the Fence, the Fifth Emperor, on Hachinosu.
arc.grandline.giants_hearth.why: Elbaph, the land of giants, answers to strength — and its Emperor knew the Saltfire King better than anyone alive.
arc.grandline.giants_hearth.cast.sigrid: Sigrid 'Hearth-Shield' Kumobashi, who does the worrying for her father.
arc.grandline.giants_hearth.cast.hrolf: The Emperor Hrolf Kumobashi, who fights with his fists and laughs with his whole chest.
recap.grandline.elbaph_1: Proved yourself against Sigrid on Elbaph and spoke with the Emperor Hrolf.
arc.grandline.unmoving_star.why: With all four rubbings, one gate remains: Lodestar Island, where the King's old cabin girl, now an Emperor, keeps his broken compass.
arc.grandline.unmoving_star.cast.asagao: Asagao 'Morning Glory' Bellweather, the reason everyone at the Captain's table behaves.
arc.grandline.unmoving_star.cast.aurelia: The Emperor Aurelia Hinode, once the Saltfire King's cabin girl.
recap.grandline.lodestar_1: Beat Morning Glory and the Emperor Aurelia, and earned the pose for the final island.
arc.grandline.saltfire.why: The final island waits. Nox 'the Miasma' Tsukuyomi, who sold the Lamplighter, got there first with CP0's last orders.
arc.grandline.saltfire.cast.nox: Nox 'the Miasma' Tsukuyomi of the Gas-Gas Fruit, everyone's friend and CP0's informant.
arc.grandline.saltfire.cast.juniper: Juniper 'Ashfoot' Kurai, who carries people down the Holy Land's back stairs to the sea.
arc.grandline.saltfire.cast.bartolo: Bartolo 'Inkwell' Scoop of the Gazette, who means to print the ending.
recap.grandline.laughtale_1: Reached the final island and beat the Miasma.
recap.grandline.laughtale_2: Read the stone at the heart of the island, and chose what the world would see.
